texto_aprovado: One scientist has put that gap into words. Kevin Arbuckle, an evolutionary biologist at Swansea University, says Australia's image as the home of highly venomous animals is, "for the most part," overstated. Its variety of venomous animals, he says, is "not unusual at all for a largely tropical area."
